Definition
[Perelman entropy and shrinker entropy] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0047 1. ch27:eq-27.115–27.118\group Logarithmic Sobolev inequality

For $\int e^{-\varphi }=(4\pi )^{n/2}$, set \[ \mathcal W(g,\varphi )=\int (R+| abla \varphi |^2+\varphi -n)(4\pi )^{-n/2}e^{-\varphi }d\mu , \quad \mu (g)=\inf _\varphi \mathcal W(g,\varphi ). \] Normalize a shrinker by $\int e^{-f}=(4\pi )^{n/2}$ and $R+| abla f|^2-f=C_1(\mathcal G)$; then $\mu (\mathcal G)=-C_1(\mathcal G)$.
